text:
Getting Started

Install sqlpipe with this command:

`curl -sSL https://get.sqlpipe.dev | sh`

This command downloads sqlpipe and installs it on your system.

After the installation, create a configuration file named `sqlpipe.yaml`. Add your source and destination values to this file.

Run sqlpipe with this command:

`sqlpipe run --config sqlpipe.yaml`

sqlpipe reads the configuration file and starts the pipeline.

If the command fails with a connection error, make sure that sqlpipe can reach your source and destination.

If `sqlpipe.yaml` contains a fault, sqlpipe stops and shows the line number of the fault.

After a successful run, sqlpipe shows a summary of the transferred rows.
